translation.name: Habo nalolene bi gahenge lo winigo ogo

content: Nadana Debidila henego ogo
Samuele homeaha Debidi kini heangi Nadana ibu Anduane Homogonaga bi mana latagi halu mbiwia haga ho aribia hene.

Wali agalime nogo balu Anduane Homogohondo bo loma bu mulenaga nogo bayale habetigi kago bowa habane abene baya kago loma bu miagane nga. Anidagua dege Anduane Homogohanda agali bayale mbira mini Debidi heago ibu dabalu Isaraele waneigini bu hearunaga agali haguane helo helene.

Debidila laiono gabua bu karubi biango handalehe timbuni mini bea karubi ibu baba hongo nakarulapeore. Laiono gabua bea gabua hongohe uruni Debidihanda mo emene halu nogo sibi memeru igini taliradagua biaga hene.

Ibu wene igiri emene dege howa ibugua agali hongohe timbuni gibiore pari wayali mbira tinaga waitigi heago balu bo homa hene. Ibugua ege to̱le̱ puha yuwa bope lalu Golaidinaga embone dambiyagola Golaidi abale ibira halu ibugua bi ko lalu hagadago ogoningi biba helene.

Debidihanda ibuha hongo holene ngibe lalu Anduane Homogo Daligaore kagohondo bi lowa ibugua hongo ogoni mo yu howa agali hongohe wai biaga pari wayali heago balu ibu wayali hene. Anidagua bialu Debidihanda ibunaga wali agalinaga mini timbuni mini lene daligaore lone wiadai bilo mo yaraga hene.
Ibugua waitigi daosini dege pira (10,000) bayagola tigua ibunaga mini yaraga hene. Ani bialu Anduane Homogohanda ibuhondo bayale biyagome ibu kini hayangi wali agalime ibunaga mini yaraga hene.
Ai Debidihanda waitigi bu hearu baba wai biai howa bibahende bope hai halu ibugua Pilidianaga hongo bopeore halu biba helenego ayu ogoni wiaabo henego ngagoni ndobe.

Horo bibahendengi Debidihanda bialu henego damene bibahende Ngode Datagaliwabe baya burugulene howa daligaore kagohondo ka̱i̱ lalu ibunaga mini timbuniore mini lene helonaga bialu haabo haga hene. Ibugua Anduane Homogohondo turu timbuni ho howa turu holene iba gana lalu haga hene.
Agalime ngitaru balu Anduane Homogonaga mini yaraga halu iba gana lelo ibunaga anda tamuha loma bu miaga dagia heago kawareni agali maru dabo helaga bini.

Ibugua horo timbuni maru Ngode Datagaliwabehondo bi lolene dabo wialu horo uruni mo timbuni howa mo bagiho wigi bini. Ani wiagola wali agalime Anduane Homogonaga mini baya burugule ngago mo yaraga halu howa egerebagiore gao laragola wali agali abaleore Ngode Datagaliwabe andaha íbu ngoai howa iba ganame gialo yu helaga hene.

Anduane Homogohanda Debidinaga ko wiaru mo wahai halu ibunaga mini timbuniore mini lene wiaabo helo helene. Anduane Homogohanda habo nalolene bi Debidila lo wialu ibuni kini helalu biyagola ainde Isaraele wali agalinaga deni Debidi ibu mini lene timbuni hene.
Solomono henego ogo

Debidi halu homayagola ibuni igini Solomonohanda ibu abanaga henge ibuni mo aribia hene. Mini gigabi wulenebi manda bayalebi ibuha to̱le howa ibu abahanda biabe bayale bu wahene wiagoria ibu bayale hene.

Solomono ibu kini heangi ibunaga holene baya gibiore wialu Anduane Homogohanda miniha mo palia holene mo karula ho helene. Ani helayagola ibugua Anduane Homogonaga anda mbira haabobo hene howa Ngode Datagaliwabenaga andaore helo lowa ibugua bia hene.
Solomono-o í̠ wene igiri emene dege hengi í̠naga manda timbuni daligaore wia heneya. Iba timbuni poragoha iba to̱latagi hagadagua mini giga bulene manda bayalebi í̠ha to̱latagihe heneya.
Í̠na wali agali dindi bibahendeha karu bi te bayale larigomebi manane bayale mo walia harigomebi ti manda bayale wáleore wiai haya.

Í̠naga mini mo yaraga halu mini lene timbuniore ka lenego dindi bibahendeha purogo lai halu dindi kaundiaore iba dege dombeneha wiaruahabi anda piai henego hale hai haya. Hale howa í̠na mana bayale bulene ngago mo heya howa bialu ke layago hale hai howa ti turu timbuniore hai ho ka.

Ainde í̠na biagago damene iba gana lo ngagobi í̠na lawai bayale haga ngegobi bi yobage laga ngegobi wali agalime í̠hondo bi maru hale haragola í̠ ladai biriligobi Ngode Datagaliwabe ibu Isaraele wali agalinaga Anduane Homogo kagonaga minini howa í̠na ngoloru silibaru dewaore mo mogo bu wu hariya.
Anigo í̠na dimagoli holeneme í̠ haru heagola walime í̠ mo pila hayaya.

Í̠ninaga mini bayalebi í̠ waneigini aguane mani hama polobadarunaga mini bayale lolenebi í̠nime ko mo hai hariya. Lulu mana ale í̠nime bialu hariyagome í̠ igini bu hearunaga miniha mo genda harigo ainde tiha ko holene anda ibiya.
Ani bialu í̠naga dindi mbiraore wiyago lone tuwuki halu Eberaimi hameigini ti mine haga mbirago hayaya.

Anigo Anduane Homogohanda í̠ dameneruhondo dara ho haabo howa ibugua í̠hondo buleore lalu bi lo wiyago mo habo nalayaya. Anduane Homogo ibunime Debidi ibuninaga biabe bia haga helo dabo helene biago mitangi bialu ibugua ibunaga nenege Debidi aria balu biba helolene hame nale hayaya. Ani hame lowa ibugua Yagaba hameigini maru helo wahalu Debidi aria nde maru helo karulapeda lo manda biniya.
Lehoboama Yoroboamala henego ogo

Ai Solomono ibu homalu ibu mamaliru baba ha̱lo paleagola ibu igini Lehoboama henegome henge mialu ho aribia hene. Agali ogoni ibu lulu mini nawiore hene. Ibugua gabumane biabe bia ko hayagome wali agali mo pila hai hene.

Mani howa agali mende Nebada igini Yaroboama ibu ho aribia howa ibugua Isaraele wali agali mana ko bulene hariga ngagoha haru halu pubagi halu ibugua Eberaimi wali agali hariga koha haru pupe hene. Ani binigome wali agalinaga ko timbuniore wu to̱le layagola Anduane Homogohanda tihondo handabe manga halu tinaga dindiha nahelo bo batagi hai hene.
Heneneore tigua mana ko tara tara wiaru bima pu dege bialu pani nolene ko tara ngola hene.
